scripts.db:init: pnpm run db:create && pnpm run migration:run
scripts.migration:generate: pnpm run build && typeorm migration:generate -d dist/shared/database/data-source.js
scripts.migration:run: pnpm run build && typeorm migration:run -d dist/shared/database/data-source.js
scripts.migration:show: pnpm run build && typeorm migration:show -d dist/shared/database/data-source.js
scripts.migration:revert: pnpm run build && typeorm migration:revert -d dist/shared/database/data-source.js
